character: Fictional Forza Motorsport original circuit set in a Vermont valley — a fast, flowing layout with sweeping corners and gentle elevation changes. No community-established corner names exist; downhill sections in particular reward precise braking and turn-in.
notes: Community knowledge (no formal, verified corner-name guide available). Character sourced from official Forza track-list description (forza.net) and community track discussion; no individual corner names are community-established, so generic Turn-N labels are used deliberately.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: medium-speed corner off the front straight
corners.trap: Running wide compromises the run into the following section

corners.name: Turn 5
corners.technique: Commit through the downhill section with smooth steering; be precise with braking and turn-in on the descent
corners.trap: Braking too late on the downhill approach and running wide

corners.name: Turn 9
corners.type: tight, technical corner in the infield
corners.technique: Patient braking, low-speed precision, prioritise a clean exit
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running out of track

corners.name: Final Corner
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the front straight
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time down the entire straight
